note: Where every shipped source file under patches/ and extensions/ came from. A rule naming a single file wins over the directory rule around it; otherwise each file matches exactly one rule. A ported rule names the upstream repository, the commit it was copied from, the repositories it came through and its licence, and every file's header names a repository of its rule, by URL. Every upstream named here must also appear in NOTICE. ProvenanceTest checks all of it. A Meta-app repository named here also has to be allowed by sources/instagram-sources.json.

rules.changes: Packages moved from app.morphe.extension to app.hushgram.extension so the payload can't collide with another Morphe source's classes. Instagram's hosts and cookie names in DiagnosticRedactor, Instagram wording in user-facing messages, HushfacebookPause renamed HushgramPause with its keys and marker file. The settings screen cut down to HushGram's patches: no Material You theme, search, section navigation, backups, release check or downloads. The Facebook compatibility target replaced with Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 and its two signer digests. LinkCleaner's key lists replaced with Instagram's own and limited to Instagram's hosts, with clipboard and share sheet stand-ins added. The extension and settings patches rewritten for InstagramAppShell and InstagramMainActivity. The translation tables pruned to the strings HushGram shows, with its new strings translated. Changed files carry a 'Modified for HushGram' line.

rules.changes: Hushfacebook's video and photo save pipeline, packages moved from app.morphe.extension.facebook to app.hushgram.extension.instagram. MediaDownload became MediaSave without its Facebook hooks: saveVideo, savePhoto and saveItem take the single files as renditions with any size and bitrate the app states, an optional DASH manifest and the post's details, and RenditionPicker ranks a stated size above the address's marker, with a stated bitrate breaking a tie. PostDetails keeps only its value and reads an Instagram media id. PlayerSources, ReelDownload, VideoMenuItem, the settings rows and the patches were left out, with the tests that only drove them. MediaStoreWriter writes the file itself on Android 9, which has no pending rows, and SaveLeftovers sweeps what that leaves. The folder, file names, notification channel and ledger are HushGram's own, and the save text names Instagram. Changed files carry a 'Modified for HushGram' line.

Hushfacebook's TapClock and the decision core of TapToPlay, packages moved from app.morphe.extension.facebook to app.hushgram.extension.instagram. Instagram's starts carry a reason string instead of Facebook's EventTriggerType, and it can't tell a tap from an automatic start, so the control triggers and the visibility triggers went: a start goes ahead on an armed player or within a second of a tap. The legacy player, the Reels play button and overlay hooks went with them. The Autoplay setting reader became a boolean filter on Instagram's VideoAutoplayChecker, and the pause hook takes Instagram's pause reason so a seek, a pinch or a reel's replay keeps the player armed. ResumePoints came over as it was. ResumePlayback kept the thresholds and the player bookkeeping, and reads Instagram's IgVideoPlayerImpl and IgVideoSource through stubs the patch fills, where it read Facebook's VideoPlayerParams by field name. Long reels resume, since Instagram posts nearly every video as a reel. The trigger enum, the release hook and the loop, GIF and audio-only checks went, and Instagram's first video start ages the saved points instead of Facebook's app start. The tests were ported with them. Changed files carry a 'Modified for HushGram' line.
